INSERT INTO users (zitadel_user_id, username, email, display_name, locale, organization,
                              email_verified, email_verified_at)
           VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, COALESCE($5, 'ru'), $6, $7, CASE WHEN $7 THEN now() END)
           ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
           RETURNING id
